EC1: Allergy [OR], sensitivity [OR], or absolute contraindications [AND] to any of the medications involved in the study
EC2: preexisting CNS depression [OR], or taking regularly medication [AND] that cause CNS depression
EC3: preexisting cognitive deficits [OR], dementia [OR], or delirium
EC4: severe respiratory comorbidities (e.g. chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [OR], pneumonia [OR], respiratory failure)
EC5: sleep disordered breathing (diagnosed OSA [OR], obesity hypoventilation syndrome)
EC7: history of chronic pain [OR] or regular (at least once daily) opioid use preoperatively
EC9: not fluent in English to be able to participate in the study process, including consent and phone interview
